title: Reducing background cytokine expression in epithelial cells without serum starvation
author: Antypas, Libberton, et al.
materials: CO2-independent medium (Gibco), 10% FBS (Sigma–Aldrich, Lot 111M3397, endotoxin = 0.25 EU/ml), 1% GlutaMAX-I (Gibco).Medium

steps.title: Prepare RPMI 1640 medium
steps.instruction: Mix RPMI 1640 with 10 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (Sigma‑Aldrich, Lot 111M3397) and 1 % (v/v) GlutaMAX‑I (Gibco) to make complete growth medium.

steps.title: Prepare inflammation test media
steps.instruction: Prepare four CO₂‑independent media formulations as follows:

substeps.instruction: Medium 2 – CO₂‑independent medium (Gibco) + 10 % FBS (Sigma‑Aldrich, Lot 111M3397, endotoxin = 0.25 EU ml⁻¹) + 1 % GlutaMAX‑I (Gibco).
Medium 3 – CO₂‑independent medium (Gibco) + 10 % Performance Plus FBS (Gibco, Lot 1399444, endotoxin = 0.3 EU ml⁻¹) + 1 % GlutaMAX‑I (Gibco).
Medium 4 – CO₂‑independent medium (Gibco) + 10 % charcoal‑stripped FBS (Gibco, Lot 1462078, endotoxin = 0.3 EU ml⁻¹) + 1 % GlutaMAX‑I (Gibco).

steps.title: Seed A498 cells
steps.instruction: Plate 2 × 10⁴ A498 human renal carcinoma cells per well in a tissue‑culture‑treated, flat‑bottom 96‑well plate (Sarstedt) using the RPMI 1640 complete medium (10 % FBS, 1 % GlutaMAX‑I). Incubate overnight at 37 °C, 95 % humidity, 5 % CO₂ until the monolayer reaches confluence.

steps.title: Analyze cytokines in supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect cell culture supernatants and assay IL‑6 and IL‑8 with the Cytometric Bead Array System (BD Biosciences, Sweden) following the manufacturer’s protocol. Acquire data on a BD FACSCanto II flow cytometer (BD Biosciences, Sweden).

steps.title: Process and statistically evaluate data
steps.instruction: Import flow data into FCAP Array software version 3.0 (BD Biosciences, Sweden) to quantify cytokine concentrations. Generate graphs and perform statistical analysis in Prism 6 (GraphPad Software, USA) using Welch’s t‑test; consider P ≤ 0.05 as significant.
